seed._note: the seed run is the owner's real account; the id carries the provider because the engine's OAuth surface resolves a BARE account id across every accountconfig kind and refuses a clash (two providers both naming their seed account `owner` collide)

_mockPort: fixed so the rewired function body is identical run to run — the engine serves the PREVIOUS apply's body (substrate#576), so a moving port makes the first drain of every run call a dead mock
_continue: the three streams stamp `<stream>SyncRequestedAck` with the request generation they acted on, and google-<stream>-on-request fires exactly while the pair disagrees. The runner stamps `syncRequestedAt` to CONTINUE a bounded drain and to RE-DRIVE a re-seeded account at all: a purge leaves the account row (and its `*LastSyncedAt`) standing, so every on-connect guard is already false on a second seed and nothing else would fire.
_faults:
NO faults.json ON DISK, DELIBERATELY. tools/e2e.py loads providers/

/e2e/faults.json whenever the FILE EXISTS — it is not gated on --mode — so a committed matrix would inject 429s, 500s and 404s into the owner SEED as well as the e2e. Every case is POSTed to /__mock/faults by e2e/scenario.py instead, guarded by MODE == e2e, which also lets each one run against an account that is already ok and assert what changed.
_drive: T-088: the fourth stream. `enabledDrive` rides beside the other three toggles, and its on-connect/on-request pair is kept enabled like theirs; the scheduled trigger is disabled for the run as every schedule is.
